source.publication: 2025 IT-140 Personal Income Tax Forms and Instructions (West Virginia Tax Division), with Schedule M bound in
source.section: Schedule M line 33(a)-(b) Other Retirement Modification, 'Combined amounts of 33a and 33b must not exceed $2,000' (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.22); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Single, age 60, a West Virginia Teachers' pension of 1,500 (line 33a) and a federal civil service pension of 1,500 (line 33b): each is under 2,000, but the two share one 2,000. filer born 1965-10-10, age 60 at December 31, 2025. Federal AGI (given) = wages 30,000.00 + West Virginia PERS/Teachers' pension 1,500.00 + federal civil service pension 1,500.00 = 33,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 33,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 17,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 33,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: line 33(a) WV Teachers'/PERS 1,500.00, line 33(b) federal retirement 1,500.00; line 33 = lesser of their sum 3,000.00 and 2,000.00 = 2,000.00; line 47: age 60, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 2,000.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 2,000.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 2,000.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 33,000.00 + 0.00 - 2,000.00 = 31,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 31,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 29,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 4,000.00 = 133.2; total 799.2 = 799.20. The Tax Table row 28,960 to under 29,020 (PDF p.38 on) gives 799; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 799.20.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
